name: ecommerce-catalog-crawler
title: E-commerce Catalog Crawler
description: Crawl an entire online store and extract every product with prices, availability and categories - full catalog exports for market research, dropshipping feeds and competitor price tracking across Shopify, WooCommerce and custom platforms.

input.title: Input schema for Pry E-commerce Catalog Crawler
input.description: Crawl an entire online store and extract every product with prices, availability and categories - full catalog exports for market research, dropshipping feeds and competitor price tracking across Shopify, WooCommerce and custom platforms.

urls.title: Target URLs
urls.description: One or more https:// URLs to process.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Hard cap on processed pages (runaway protection).

category_filter.title: Category URL contains
category_filter.description: Only crawl product URLs matching this path fragment.

max_items.title: Max items (cost cap)
max_items.description: Hard cap on processed items for this run - keeps trial costs predictable. Billing stops when the cap or your spending limit is reached.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Apify proxy settings passed through to Pry's premium-proxy tier. Leave default to use the platform proxy automatically.
